Name: Build You a Greenhouse
Author: monikerbandit
Description:
[size=5]Build You a Greenhouse![/size]

This is a simple Solid Foundations pack which adds four buildable greenhouses to Robin's construction menu.
You can build as many greenhouses as you can fit on your farm. Keep it clean for symmetry or go nuts for capitalism!

There are four greenhouse sizes available, from micro to jumbo.

The greenhouses are unlocked for building based on Farming skill level, with the micro unlocked at Level 2.
Each size up has increased cash and material costs.

BYA Greenhouse is my update to the various buildable greenhouse mods out there, simplified to use only Solid Foundations.
You can adjust building requirements by editing the building.json files. See the Solid Foundations wiki for details.

Please post questions under Posts and report bugs under Bugs.
